The starting state of the menu will appear collapsed on smaller screens. When toggled using the button above (mobile screens), the menu will open/close.

Make sure to keep all page content within the #main-content . The top navbar is optional and can be removed. Just create an element with the #sidebarToggle ID which will toggle the menu when clicked.
